finding: The study reported the distribution of delivery modes among 70 pregnant women, showing 32 spontaneous vaginal deliveries, 2 caesarean sections, and 1 instrumental delivery in the paracetamol group, compared to 22 normal deliveries, 8 caesarean deliveries, and 5 instrumental deliveries in the control group.
mod_finding: In the paracetamol group, 32 women had spontaneous vaginal delivery, 2 underwent caesarean section, and 1 (1.4%) had instrumental delivery, while in the control group, 22 women (31.4%) had normal delivery, 8 underwent caesarean delivery, and 5 had instrumental delivery.
